title: Extraction
description: Extracts the findings of the last completed ATC run (series ZMIG_ / Z_MIG_) and prepares the remediation.
pickEnvironment: Choose the customer and the environment to see the last ATC run.
latest.title: Last ATC run
latest.inProgressHint: The extraction always uses the last completed run; the ones in progress are only used once they finish.
runner.title: Extract findings
runner.hint: Reads the findings from SAP and saves the total CSV, the new ones (no baseline) and the remediation one.
runner.hintForce: This run was already extracted. A new extraction (force) creates another record with the same SAP data.
runner.confirmText: Run {{id}} was already extracted. Forcing creates a new extraction of the same ATC run. Continue?
busy.open: See the run that is blocking: {{kind}} (started by {{by}})
findings.title: Findings of extraction {{id}}
findings.description: Filter by priority, object and baseline.
remediation.title: Remediation of extraction {{id}}
remediation.description: Choose the priority scope. Only findings without baseline are included.
remediation.prioritiesHint: The session and the CSV use only the new findings in these priorities.
remediation.requestHint: Optional; uses the environment's default request when there is one.
history.title: Extraction history
history.empty: No extraction in this environment yet.
monitor.title: Extraction
monitor.description: Start the extraction of several customers and environments at once and follow them all at the same time.
monitor.force: Extract again the runs already extracted (force)
monitor.hint: Each environment becomes its own run. Different environments run in parallel up to the server limit; the rest waits in the queue. Without force, an ATC run already extracted ends as "already extracted" without saving again.
new.title: New extraction
